name: Ilhan Omar
summary: Ilhan Abdullahi Omar (born October 4, 1982) is an  American politician serving as the U.S. representative for Minnesota's 5th congressional district since 2019. The district includes all of Minneapolis and some of its first-ring suburbs. From 2017 to 2019, Omar served in the Minnesota House of Representatives, representing part of Minneapolis.
